title: Infrequent Shoppers, Pantry Stockers
description: This segment purchases fewer items and places fewer orders overall. They show a strong preference for pantry staples like canned goods and dry pasta. While exploring new products, their reorder rate is lower than average.

title: Care and Household Essentials Shoppers
description: This segment heavily prioritizes purchases in personal care, household goods, and pet supplies. They buy fewer total items compared to the average customer. Their basket is less focused on fresh produce and deli/meat items, suggesting a preference for pantry stocking and upkeep.  This group may be more budget-conscious or focused on recurring needs.

title: Engaged Families, Diverse Shoppers
description: This segment exhibits a strong tendency to purchase a wide variety of products across numerous departments. They buy more items per order and show a higher reorder rate. Their purchases indicate a focus on baby products and a broader selection beyond just staples.

title: Frequent, Diverse, and Loyal Buyers
description: This segment consists of highly engaged customers who purchase frequently and explore a wide variety of products across many aisles. They demonstrate a strong preference for baby products and a lower inclination towards alcohol. Their reorder rate is significantly higher, indicating strong loyalty and satisfaction with the service.

title: Beverage & Alcohol Focused Indulgers
description: This segment heavily prioritizes alcoholic beverages and other drinks, representing a significant portion of their purchases. They also show a strong preference for snacks, indicating a tendency towards impulse buys and treats. Conversely, they purchase very little in categories like dry goods, baby items, and meat.

title: Produce Enthusiasts, Low Basket Size
description: This segment overwhelmingly prioritizes produce purchases, spending 55% of their budget here. They exhibit a significantly lower overall basket size compared to the average customer. Notably, they show minimal to no interest in categories like pets, alcohol, and baby products. Their purchasing behavior is concentrated on fresh items with fewer overall products.

title: Frequent Fresh & Frozen Buyers
description: This segment prioritizes fresh bakery, breakfast, and deli items, alongside a strong preference for frozen goods. They tend to purchase a moderate number of items, with a lower proportion of unique products. Their shopping behavior suggests a focus on meal ingredients and potentially convenience.
